format: WSDC Relative Placement and NDCA Skating System: algorithm text
requirement: NOT SPECIFIED IN PROVIDED SOURCE: the WSDC Relative Placement final-scoring algorithm (3.4.9.d defers to the WSDC website) and the NDCA Skating System algorithm (III.D.11 requires it without defining it). Public candidate documents are recorded as UNREVIEWED in the OD-24 source note and are not authoritative. No behavior is invented and nothing is built from them.

interpretation_notes: Promotion of a candidate needs independent review of applicability, completeness and authority. UCWDC Majority Rules v16.9b is the only body algorithm fully specified in the supplied sources (OD-24 source note section 7).
